executor_visible_question: A PHP 7.1 declared-floor CI job fails during Composer dependency resolution. Identify the smallest valid change that would restore the build without disabling or weakening its check.

full.description: unbounded reference, cat of the original bytes

tail_c.description: tail -c <budget>; may begin mid-line (reported, never repaired)

rg_generic.description: task-agnostic failure-marker regex with symmetric context, line-numbered

rg_actions_annotation.description: GitHub Actions' own error-annotation marker with symmetric context, line-numbered

predeclaration: Patterns, context sizes and budgets were fixed before any strategy output was measured and are not tuned afterwards. Strategy commands never read the evaluator file.

reasons: PHPStan --error-format=agent formats PHPStan results only, not a GitHub job log.

gh run view --log-failed filters a live Actions API log of a run the CI token cannot read (another repository) and not the preserved immutable bytes; it is recorded only as a local informational observation, outside the CI proof.

disposition_rule.NATIVE_FILTER_SUFFICIENT_FOR_THIS_CASE: at least one native strategy is within the 8192-byte budget (no OVER_BUDGET) and retains every required critical item; the smallest budget at which this holds is reported
disposition_rule.NATIVE_FILTER_INSUFFICIENT: no native strategy is within 8192 bytes while retaining every required critical item
disposition_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: harness invariants (hash match, determinism, complete report) fail

limitations: One case; a mechanical line-presence rubric, not a human or model judgement of sufficiency.
The critical span sits at the end of this log, so a plain tail is expected to be favourable; the case cannot discriminate position-agnostic selectors.
No model was run; no token, cost or task-success claim.
Original job log bytes include GitHub's log representation (BOM, ANSI escapes, timestamps).
